description.narrative: To enhance national unity and inter-racial harmony in Malaysia, and specifically: -To encourage ratification of ICERD as a symbol of Malaysias commitment to a more equal and harmonious world;To improve the level of understanding and support for ICERD among selected target groups in Malaysia; To mobilize cross-partisan social support for an open and constructive dialogue on ICERD; To enhance the capacity of IDEAS to engage in debate on economic, political and civil rights; and enhance the space for an objective and evidence based dialogue on the issues related with racial discrimination.
